correctness.rationale: Channel definition inspected: at most one transposition of unequal adjacent binary symbols followed by at most one deletion, with both operations optional. Reconstructed each of 64 mixed-length descendant balls and all 2,016 unordered compatibility tests, obtaining exactly 928 compatible edges. Independent unpruned exhaustive maximal-clique enumeration, not a heuristic bound, gives 2921 maximal cliques and sizes 3:218, 4:1861, 5:816, 6:26. Consequently maximum 6 and precisely 26 labeled maximizers; intersection of 26 codebooks consists of 000000 and 111111; reversal/complement orbit sizes sorted 1,1,2,2,2,2,4,4,4,4. The exact n=6 claim is a finite theorem and the enumeration truly traverses its full finite domain; no inference to other lengths.
